notes: Self-contained WebGPU/TSL 2.5D walking sample; HTML only bootstraps the module graph.
Photoreal 2D tree and walker cutouts stand as face-on cards in a 3D Hawkesbury riverbank.
Native RTX ray queries supply sun shadows/AO and one-bounce river reflections against a static terrain/tree-proxy snapshot.
The walker, water transport and dirt-road locomotion remain JavaScript-authored.
No native/C++ runtime files or downloaded models are required.
